snippet.title: No Straight Roads: Encore Edition Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Let’s rocketok! No Straight Roads: Encore Edition is releasing on 21st October 2021 on Steam!

Experience the enhanced version of the original music action-adventure that features the rock-tastic base game and festive-focused ‘Christmas Edition’ update, plus brand new content, including an expanded collection of tracks, a new opening cinematic, quality of life improvements and over 500 pieces of fan art available to view and collect throughout Vinyl City!

Get ready for an encore and wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726190/No_Straight_Roads_Encore_Edition/

Curious about its features? Watch the feature trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0OPM8qUe2r8
